scope: Independent shipped-file scan of all six base atlases and twelve alternate atlases. Direct visual review covered every authored pose in native/integer contact sheets. Integrated captures, runtime timing and gameplay require their own evidence.

visual_findings.issue: Ivory shoulder armor vanished during side running and attack
visual_findings.status: repaired in ten dynamic poses by one unchanged native armor cutout

visual_findings.issue: Moth spread-to-folded charge snapped and folded upper tips touched the atlas top
visual_findings.status: repaired by two native intermediate wing positions and a one-row upper inset

visual_findings.issue: Three airborne hound poses introduced opaque pixels on the upper cell border
visual_findings.status: repaired by native upper-cap inset and gutter-constrained rigid shoulder placement

visual_findings.issue: Skin-dependent death pixel counts advanced the shared gameplay RNG differently
visual_findings.status: root isolated reference death RNG; implementation reviewed; root owns executable verification

aesthetic_review.sproutling: The low oatcap and upright petal/sepals form different heads and bodies, retained across hopping, stretch, impact and recovery poses.
aesthetic_review.thorn_imp: Birch forked mask/rose lichen and broad bracken/raffia profiles read as distinct materials; the same held object remains legible through each throw.
aesthetic_review.crystal_beetle: Broken quartz bowl and ribbed fossil valves replace the tall spike body with two coherent shells. Both retain a violet cleft and charge-to-dazed brightness progression.
aesthetic_review.ember_hound: Ivory rib armor and a rigid jasper shoulder distinguish both skins through all poses; the repaired side movement no longer loses the ivory shoulder.
aesthetic_review.wisp: Moon-moth wings and a hanging lantern cage differ in anatomy, retaining the shared small bright firing heart. Intermediate native wing positions clarify the fold.
aesthetic_review.spitting_totem: Twin copper flues and an ivory ceramic arch have clear silhouettes and grounded plinths; the inset fixed firing outlet stays visibly joined to each chassis.

runtime_review.scope: Six families sampled in actual three-region combat; source review separately covers all directions, all phases and all 610 alternates. No audio audition or game-balance claim.
runtime_review.verdict: No blocking enemy art regression found after the native repairs.
residuals: Existing Bloomwild vegetation/arch occlusion can hide small enemies.
God-tour attack spam displays many hurt flashes, which undersells the art.
